question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Wear your heart on your sleeve
solution:
The correct answer is __**To **show your true emotions__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **To wear one's heart on one's sleeve:** to show one's emotions very openly

 
 
• He*** wears his heart on his sleeve.***
 
 
 
• So, *To show your true emotions* is the best choice of our answer.
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer.
